_README: UI Layout Engine (global CLAUDE.md §13) layout INTENT for this project, one entry per registered element, keyed by the same id src/main.js passes to createUIElement(). This is git-tracked declared intent, not resolved geometry — the engine turns it into native CSS custom properties/classes at runtime (see lib/ui-engine/engine.css). Edit it here, or live via the dev panel's UI Layout Inspector; the Inspector's own Save writes back through the storage backend src/main.js registers.

appStage._comment: The app root. Covers the full viewport. Deliberately NOT size:fill — fill resolves via flexbox and is only meaningful inside a flow parent (see engine.css's .ui-size-w-fill); this element's parent is <body>, not a flex container, so an explicit fixed 100vw/100vh is the correct mode, exactly as the engine's own demo/config.json does for its stage.
